title: GTA 6 Has No Darts. Rockstar Says Why
short_title: GTA 6 has no darts. Rockstar says why #GTA6 #Shorts
short_title_options: GTA 6 has no darts. Rockstar says why #GTA6 #Shorts
Rockstar: even we don't have unlimited time (GTA 6) #GTA6 #Shorts
GTA 6 cut darts and bowling. Here's why #GTA6 #Shorts
short_description:
Rob Nelson, co-studio head of Rockstar North, told Video Games Chronicle (Nov 19) why darts didn't make GTA 6: "The darts one is a contentious one... you hear they have unlimited money or unlimited time, even we do not." Pool made it in; darts and bowling were cut. Rockstar hasn't said if they'll be added later.

Sources: VGC interview (videogameschronicle.com), GGRecon, GameNewsPlus, GTABase (pool activity). No spoilers.

short_es.title: GTA 6 NO tiene dardos... Rockstar explica por qué 🎯 #GTA6 #Shorts
short_es.description: Rob Nelson, codirector de Rockstar North, le dijo a Video Games Chronicle (19 de nov.) por qué no hay dardos en GTA 6: "Lo de los dardos es un tema polémico... se oye que tienen dinero ilimitado o tiempo ilimitado; ni siquiera nosotros" (traducido). El billar sí llegó; los dardos y los bolos no. Rockstar no ha dicho si los agregará después. Sin spoilers.
